title: Application of Western Massachusetts Electric Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 896, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a semi-annual fuel charge as adopted in D.P.U. 95-8A to be billed to the Company's customers pursusnant to meter readings in the billing months of March, April and May, 1997. Application is also made by Western Massachusetts Electric Company for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchase power, pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00 and M.D.P.U. 586 during the same time period.
